verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe Bots running on a persistent cloud computer that keeps working while your laptop is closed. Skills can be saved and rerun on a schedule (e.g. every weekday at 8 AM), and routines can be triggered by events such as Slack messages or GitHub notifications. Month-long community users independently confirm that async, always-on work 'actually works', including multi-bot autonomous tasks. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of failure handling and monitoring for unattended routines.
